metadata.governingEquations: eta_t + ((h+eta)*w)_z = 0; (I - D) w_t = -w*w_z - g*eta_z; Discrete (I - D) psi = psi - alpha * [1/2 * h * delta_z^2(h psi) - 1/6 * h^2 * delta_z^2(psi)]
metadata.discreteOperatorMatch: Exact discrete matrix A_j, B_j, C_j matching GPU Boussinesq.compute RunTridiagonalZ
metadata.operatorDerivationNote: Peregrine (1967) eq (2.11) in depth-averaged velocity u* has dispersion term 1/2*h*(h*u)_{xxt} - 1/6*h^2*u_{xxt}. Taylor expanded on smooth beds, this yields alpha * [1/3*h^2*psi_zz + h*h_z*psi_z + 1/2*h*h_zz*psi], confirming slope coeff is 1.0 and curvature coeff is 0.5. The previous mention of slope_coeff=0.5 as "classical Peregrine" was a misconception and has been retracted.
metadata.spatialDiscretizationNote: Interior spatial derivatives are 4th-order central difference; dispersion inversion (I-D) uses exact 2nd-order 3-point tridiagonal solve matching GPU. Overall spatial scheme is 2nd-order accurate, not 4th-order.

initialSolitaryWave.formula: eta = a0 * sech^2(kappa0 * (z - z0)), w = c0 * eta / (h + eta)

flatBedVerification.description: With prominence threshold >= 0.005m, exactly 1 solitary wave is detected (height=0.1273m, retention=106% due to high-order nonlinear crest profile). Small background dispersion ripples (<0.002m) exist behind the pulse.

extendedShelfSolitonFission.observation: At t=14s on the shelf, an undular bore with a shoaled lead peak and trailing oscillations is present. As the wave propagates over distance on the shelf (t=26s, 32s), distinct rank-ordered solitary peaks emerge.

discreteOperatorEquivalence.description: Verified discrete operator equivalence against GPU RunTridiagonalZ via Docs/VerifyDiscreteDispersionOperator.py.
discreteOperatorEquivalence.curvedBedCurvatureTermAction: Constant psi=1 produces action -1/2 * h * h_zz matching theory to 9.55e-08
discreteOperatorEquivalence.shelfKinksHandling: Piecewise linear kinks at z=10m and z=18m are handled natively at discrete stencil without singularity
